data.name: Blue-Ex Limited
data.description: Blue-Ex Limited was incorporated as a private limited company in Pakistan on December 12, 2005 under the repealed Companies Ordinance, 1984 (now Companies Act, 2017), The Principal activities of the company are to act as a cargo forwarder, provide domestic and international courier and allied services.
